extraFacts.fact: Corrugated metal hose terms: annular corrugation is a series of parallel rings (versus helical, a continuous spiral); braid is a woven wire sleeve that contains pressure; ISO 10380 covers corrugated metal hoses and hose assemblies, with a safety factor of 4:1 on burst pressure as quoted in the listings; hoses are hydrotested at 1.5 times working pressure.
extraFacts.source: ISO 10380 (corrugated metal hoses and hose assemblies); manufacturer listings

faqs.q: What is the Senior Flexonics Bartlett Fire-Safe Hose Assembly used for?
faqs.a: A Senior Flexonics all-metal corrugated hose assembly for hydrocarbon and process lines where a rubber hose would fail in a fire. Typical uses include hydrocarbon transfer near fire risk, refinery and petrochemical flexible connections and pump and equipment connections in fire zones. See the [fire protection & specialty cores](/c/metallic-fire-protection-hoses).

faqs.q: is the Senior Flexonics Bartlett Fire-Safe Hose Assembly suitable for sour-service (H₂S) wells?
faqs.a: Yes — fully NACE MR0175 / ISO 15156 compliant. Type 316L SS core meets NACE hardness limits. Tell us the application and we check it against the specification.

faqs.q: Senior Flexonics Bartlett Fire-Safe Hose Assembly: what materials are used in construction?
faqs.a: Core / wrap: Type 316L SS. Braid: Double Braid of Type 316L SS. End fittings: 316L SS standard with fire-test-certified flange seals. If you are unsure, send us the requirement and we will confirm.

faqs.q: What should I know before ordering the Senior Flexonics Bartlett Fire-Safe Hose Assembly?
faqs.a: All-metal construction — stainless corrugated core and braid — is fire-resistant by construction. Fire-test standards differ: API 607, API 6FA and ISO 10497 are valve fire tests, so ask for the evidence that applies to a hose assembly. Pressure, temperature and end connections confirmed per build. Give the full duty on your request for the Senior Flexonics Bartlett Fire-Safe Hose Assembly.

faqs.q: Senior Flexonics Bartlett Fire-Safe Hose Assembly: what sizes are available?
faqs.a: DN 13 (1/2") to DN 100 (4"). Designed to fit over the standard hose bore range — confirm host hose OD on the RFQ. Send us the details and we confirm the specification before supply.

faqs.q: What do I send to order the Senior Flexonics Bartlett Fire-Safe Hose Assembly?
faqs.a: To order the Senior Flexonics Bartlett Fire-Safe Hose Assembly, send the fluid, its pressure and temperature, the bore, overall length, both end connections and any standard or certificate the project needs. We confirm the build and its ratings with the maker before quoting, and supply the test certificate with the assembly.

faqs.q: Senior Flexonics Bartlett Fire-Safe Hose Assembly: what is the operating temperature range?
faqs.a: -200°C to +815°C continuous. During fire exposure, the wrap temperature can briefly exceed the continuous limit per the applicable fire-test specification.

faqs.q: what fire rating does the Senior Flexonics Bartlett Fire-Safe Hose Assembly provide?
faqs.a: Designed to maintain hose integrity during fire-exposure events per applicable insulation regulations. Specific fire-rating duration depends on the host hose construction and the surrounding installation. Indus supplies fire-test certificates per OEM testing protocol.

faqs.q: Senior Flexonics Bartlett Fire-Safe Hose Assembly: what standards and certifications are supplied?
faqs.a: ISO 10380:2012. PED 2014/68/EU Module H. EN 13480, ASME B31.3. NACE MR0175 / ISO 15156. EN 10204 3.1 / 3.2 mill test reports. If you are unsure, send us the requirement and we will confirm.

faqs.q: Where is the Senior Flexonics Bartlett Fire-Safe Hose Assembly typically used?
faqs.a: The Senior Flexonics Bartlett Fire-Safe Hose Assembly has several listed uses. Listed uses: hydrocarbon transfer near fire risk; refinery and petrochemical flexible connections; pump and equipment connections in fire zones.

faqs.q: why the Senior Flexonics Bartlett Fire-Safe Hose Assembly specialty design?
faqs.a: Fry-Sil silica-based fabric maintains structural integrity through fire-exposure events. Used as outer wrap on metallic and industrial hoses where fire-survivability regulations apply.

faqs.q: Is the Senior Flexonics Bartlett Fire-Safe Hose Assembly in stock in Dubai?
faqs.a: Yes, we carry the Senior Flexonics Bartlett Fire-Safe Hose Assembly in stock at our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, and ship worldwide with the best lead times. Builds are quoted per bore, length and end connection. Request pricing for your sizes through [our contact page](/contact).

faqs.q: What is the Thorburn AF Series, Ball-Joint Armor-Flex Hose Guard, 304 SS used for?
faqs.a: The Thorburn AF Series Armor-Flex hose guard in 304 stainless steel is an outer shield for metallic and elastomeric hoses, made of concave and convex sections that roll off each other. Typical uses include hoses near hot work, furnaces and molten metal, hoses exposed to impact or dragging and abrasion protection on moving equipment. See the [fire protection & specialty cores](/c/metallic-fire-protection-hoses).

faqs.q: What is the Thorburn AF Series, Ball-Joint Armor-Flex Hose Guard, 304 SS made of?
faqs.a: The Thorburn AF Series, Ball-Joint Armor-Flex Hose Guard, 304 SS: Ball-joint sections slide over the hose and articulate with it. Protects against impact, abrasion and molten splash.

faqs.q: why the Thorburn AF Series, Ball-Joint Armor-Flex Hose Guard, 304 SS specialty design?
faqs.a: Ball-joint Armor-Flex consists of articulated ball-joint links that pivot at each segment. Provides impact / abrasion resistance with full articulation around the host hose.

faqs.q: Thorburn AF Series, Ball-Joint Armor-Flex Hose Guard, 304 SS: what sizes are available?
faqs.a: Fits DN 25 (1") to DN 200 (8") host hoses. Designed to fit over the standard hose bore range — confirm host hose OD on the RFQ. Tell us the application and we check it against the specification.

faqs.q: What do I send to order the Thorburn AF Series, Ball-Joint Armor-Flex Hose Guard, 304 SS?

faqs.q: Thorburn AF Series, Ball-Joint Armor-Flex Hose Guard, 304 SS: what materials are used in construction?
faqs.a: Core / wrap: Type 304 SS. End fittings: 304 SS welded ball-joint segments. Tell us the application and we check it against the specification.

faqs.q: What else should I know about the Thorburn AF Series, Ball-Joint Armor-Flex Hose Guard, 304 SS?
faqs.a: Combined with insulation, Thorburn rates Armor-Flex for environments up to 1100 °C. Offered in carbon steel (AF), 304 stainless (AFS4) and 316 stainless (AFS6).
